messages:
emma (billing): FYI HeliosCare (cust_9843) — invoice INV-2026-324 has 4 failed attempts today. Customer asked to pay by wire. Card on file returns 'processing_error' and issuer decline. Can we send wire instructions and approve waiving late fee if they complete same-day? @maya?

sam (rev-ops): What's the invoice amount and due date? Also did we capture a chargeback risk flag?

emma (billing): Amount $19,450, due 2026-03-20. No chargeback flag currently. Invoice link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-324 

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 4 attempts (2026-03-18T13:58:11Z, 14:02:23Z, 14:15:04Z, 14:47:55Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; network_response: processing_error

maya (finance): Ok — two things: 1) We should make one last auto-retry with a soft decline flow (CVV recheck) if the card is from the same BIN and customer can confirm CVV quickly. 2) If they insist on wire, we usually waive late fees on first-time emergency wires for enterprise customers; need @tara for compliance sign-off.

jonathan (acct-mgr): I spoke with their billing contact. They want wire today to avoid service interruption. I'll send the payment instructions once we confirm policy. Can someone paste the wire details and the exact wording we use for customers? I'll email and CC support.

emma (billing): Copy of bank instructions (share for email template):
```
Bank: First Capital Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 0123456789
Routing (ACH/ABA): 021000021
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-2026-324 / HeliosCare (cust_9843)
```
Notes: ask customer to include invoice ref and send proof of transfer.

tara (compliance): Approve waiving one-time late fee ($75) if payment funds are received and posted within 48h of wire initiation AND treasury confirms origin bank matches KYC. Please add a note to the customer record and attach the proof of transfer when you mark paid.

maya (finance): Approved from finance side — waive late fee. Also please do the last soft retry before sending wire, but if customer insists now, proceed with wire flow and mark invoice pending until funds arrive.

jonathan (acct-mgr): I'll email them now with the wire block + required docs template. Template snippet: "Please initiate an ACH/wire with the details below, include invoice number in reference and send a screenshot of the transfer confirmation to billing@redwood.ai. Once funds clear we'll mark INV-2026-324 as paid and remove any service holds."

sam (rev-ops): After wire is confirmed, run the usage reconciliation and set payment method to 'wired' in the billing system, then kick off the post-payment webhook to the customer org.

emma (billing): Thanks all — I'll post the wire instructions in the account thread and waive the fee once treasury confirms the transfer. Moving to "awaiting customer wire". :thumbsup:
